# Test filenames show their harness and the behavior under test

In these test directories, preserve the harness prefix and use a descriptive behavior or API stem: browser_deletionFromThreads.js, browser_treeListbox.js and test_ext_messages_listInlineTextParts.js. The historical commits registered tests in browser.ini/xpcshell.ini/xpcshell-local.ini. Current accepted manifests have migrated to browser.toml/xpcshell.toml/xpcshell-local.toml, and widget tests now live in mail/base/test/browser/widgets. A dedicated bug regression can retain a bug ID, as in test_ext_messages_bug_1737532.js. Snake-separated stems and lowerCamelCase feature stems coexist. Follow the nearby naming family instead of imposing a global dash rule. Named add_task functions state behavior, such as delete_from_collapsed_thread. This is a proposed scoped naming convention from code.

Scope: test naming.

Paths:

- `mail/test/browser/folder-display/browser_deletionFromThreads.js`
- `mail/components/extensions/test/xpcshell/test_ext_messages_listInlineTextParts.js`
- `mail/base/test/widgets/browser_treeListbox.js`
- `mail/components/extensions/test/xpcshell/xpcshell-local.toml`
- `mail/base/test/browser/widgets/browser_treeListbox.js`
- `mail/test/browser/folder-display/browser.toml`
